subject: CS351
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos covering all 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The English selections are strong, featuring high-quality animations and clear explanations from popular channels. The Arabic selection was more challenging, with one video chosen under the low-view-count exception due to a lack of high-view candidates. For the 'Lifecycle of an I/O Request' topic in English, a partially relevant video was chosen as all perfectly matched candidates failed the view count gate.
